purpose: Bounded fixed-condition comparison of whether a warranted method changes outcome, trajectory, or claim evidence without rewarding method activation.

fixed_conditions.requirement: Review a parser whose happy-path example does not cover the invalid-input equivalence class.
fixed_conditions.acceptance_oracle: the response adds a failure-sensitive invalid-input boundary test or explicitly limits the claim

cases.protected_negative: method naming or extra prose without an oracle change is not a gain

fixed_conditions.requirement: Review a privacy design before and after repository discovery establishes the data map.
fixed_conditions.acceptance_oracle: the first turn retains a fallback and limitation and the changed fact enables one ready realization without invented prerequisites

cases.protected_negative: reselection on unchanged facts or invented readiness is a regression

fixed_conditions.requirement: Audit whether a model-evaluation result is trustworthy enough for a bounded release claim.
fixed_conditions.acceptance_oracle: the result separates case, grader, infrastructure, contamination, and candidate failure and narrows unsupported claims

cases.protected_negative: higher activation, artifact count, or an aggregate score is not a gain
